description: Competing separators (motif vs compartment) and conservation of the yeast Ccs1 Mia40-docking disulfide
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import fisher_exact

# Competing separators, all computed in this job
D = pd.DataFrame([
 # protein, set, twin motif, UniProt-IMS, peroxisomal
 ("CSD1","dep",False,False,False),("CSD3","dep",False,False,True),("CCS","dep",False,False,False),
 ("AIM1","dep",False,False,True),("SLP2","dep",False,False,False),
 ("TIM8","ind",True,True,False),("TIM9","ind",True,True,False),("TIM10","ind",True,True,True),
 ("TIM13","ind",True,True,False),("COX17-1","ind",True,True,False),("COX17-2","ind",True,True,False),
 ("COX19-2","ind",True,False,False),("CCMH","ind",False,False,False),("AAC1","ind",False,False,False),
], columns=["protein","set","twin_motif","UniProt_IMS","peroxisome"])
CI = pd.DataFrame([("NDUFS5-A",True),("NDUFS5-B",True),("NDUFA8-A",True),("NDUFA8-B",True),("NDUFB7",True)],
                  columns=["protein","twin_motif"])

def ftest(col, df=D):
    d=df[df.set=="dep"]; i=df[df.set=="ind"]
    a,b=int(d[col].sum()),int((~d[col]).sum()); c,dd=int(i[col].sum()),int((~i[col]).sum())
    return a,a+b,c,c+dd,fisher_exact([[a,b],[c,dd]])[1]

print("=== Table 6. Competing separators of the two sets (same 5 vs 9 proteins) ===")
rows=[]
for col,lab in [("twin_motif","twin CX3C or CX9C"),("UniProt_IMS","annotated mito IMS"),
                ("peroxisome","peroxisomal")]:
    a,n1,c,n2,p=ftest(col)
    rows.append(dict(separator=lab, dependent=f"{a}/{n1}", independent=f"{c}/{n2}", fisher_p=round(p,4)))
# motif test with complex I subunits added to the dependent side
dep_all = pd.concat([D[D.set=="dep"][["protein","twin_motif"]], CI])
a=int(dep_all.twin_motif.sum()); b=len(dep_all)-a
i=D[D.set=="ind"]; c=int(i.twin_motif.sum()); dd=len(i)-c
p_ci=fisher_exact([[a,b],[c,dd]])[1]
rows.append(dict(separator="twin motif, complex I CHCH subunits added to dependent set",
                 dependent=f"{a}/{a+b}", independent=f"{c}/{c+dd}", fisher_p=round(p_ci,4)))
S=pd.DataFrame(rows); print(S.to_string(index=False))
S.to_csv("mia40_competing_separators.csv",index=False)

# ---- Figure: motif vs compartment, and the CCS docking-cysteine result ----
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13.5,5.6),gridspec_kw={"width_ratios":[1.15,1]})
ax=axes[0]
labs=["twin CX3C /\nCX9C motif","annotated\nmito IMS","peroxisomal","twin motif,\n+complex I\nCHCH subunits"]
ps=[ftest("twin_motif")[4],ftest("UniProt_IMS")[4],ftest("peroxisome")[4],p_ci]
cols=["#B5495B","#3C6E99","#7A9A5B","#9B9B9B"]
x=np.arange(4)
ax.bar(x,[-np.log10(v) for v in ps],0.6,color=cols)
ax.axhline(-np.log10(0.05),ls="--",lw=1,color="#444444")
ax.text(3.45,-np.log10(0.05)+0.03,"p = 0.05",fontsize=9,ha="right",color="#444444")
ax.axhline(-np.log10(0.005),ls=":",lw=1,color="#444444")
ax.text(3.45,-np.log10(0.005)+0.03,"Bonferroni, 10 features",fontsize=9,ha="right",color="#444444")
for i_,v in enumerate(ps): ax.text(i_,-np.log10(v)+0.04,f"p={v:.3f}",ha="center",fontsize=9)
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(labs,fontsize=9); ax.set_ylabel("-log10 Fisher p")
ax.set_title("Compartment separates the sets as well as cysteine motif",fontsize=11,loc="left")
for sp in ("top","right"): ax.spines[sp].set_visible(False)

ax=axes[1]; ax.axis("off")
ax.set_title("Yeast Mia40 docking disulfide of Ccs1 is not conserved",fontsize=11,loc="left")
tbl=[["orthologue","MxCxxC Cu site","yeast C27","yeast C64"],
     ["S. cerevisiae Ccs1 P40202","C17 / C20","C27","C64"],
     ["H. sapiens CCS O14618","C22 / C25","S32","T69"],
     ["A. thaliana CCS Q9LD47","C97 / C100","K107","T144"]]
for ri,row in enumerate(tbl):
    for ci_,cell in enumerate(row):
        ax.text(0.02+ci_*0.26, 0.82-ri*0.13, cell, fontsize=10,
                fontweight="bold" if ri==0 else "normal",
                color="#B5495B" if (ri>1 and ci_>1) else "#222222", va="center")
ax.text(0.02,0.26,"Needleman-Wunsch, BLOSUM62, gap -11/-1 (computed here).\n"
                  "C27-C64 is the only experimentally defined MIA40 docking\n"
                  "determinant for a non-twin-motif substrate (PMID 21865601,\n"
                  "21865594). It is absent from both plant and human CCS, yet\n"
                  "both are MIA40/Mia40-dependent.",fontsize=9.5,va="top",color="#444444")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
